summary: Gate facts: the farm's own Newbook engine quotes $44 midweek / $50 Saturday (2026-11 and 2027-06; before tax), weekly $35/night; the lodging page still says $49. Cheapest real RV night $44 - under $50, passes; the Saturday $50 is at the line, not over it. No gateway within 40 km (Atlanta 252 km); not a Good Sam Park; never stayed. Presence: operator page + engine + phone 229-641-2081. Full hookups 30/50 A (electric 50); 7 spots, 40/60/70 ft. Pin is on the RV loop. Note cleaned (rate and RV Life line are in fields).
